title: Execution Result
description: What the Execution Agent returns for one mission. Status answers what happened to the test; failure_classification answers whose fault it was. The two axes stay orthogonal.

run_id.description: Identifies this execution. Also substituted into mission naming patterns so re-runs never collide.

requirement_ref.description: [R2] Copied forward from the mission so a result traces back to the requirement, not just the test id.

test_objective.description: Copied from the mission so a report is readable without opening it.

failure_kind.description: [R2] What kind of thing stopped the run, recorded by the executor as raw input to the classifier. It is an observation, not a verdict - the executor never says whose fault the failure was.

steps_executed.description: Ordered record of what actually happened, one entry per attempted action.

expected.description: The assertion statements from the mission, verbatim.

actual.description: What was observed for each assertion. Observation only - never an interpretation of why.

evaluable.description: [R2] False when the check could not be turned into a real expectation. Unevaluable means INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

evidence.description: Paths relative to the project root. Sufficient for a human to review without re-running.

replayable_trace.description: [R2] The ordered resolved locators and actions actually used. Costs nothing to emit and is the highest-leverage artifact here: it feeds the locator cache, it makes the deterministic replay possible, and it turns the eventual conversion to permanent Playwright tests into codegen instead of re-authoring.

replay.description: [R2] Result of the one deterministic replay attempted after a failure.

artifacts_left_behind.description: [R2] What this run created on STAGE and did not remove. Manual cleanup in POC-1, but never invisible.

failure_classification.description: Null on PASS. Proposed by the classifier pass, NOT by the executor - an agent that just failed is the least reliable narrator of why. The human at Gate 2 accepts or overrides.

classification_source.description: [R2] Records who decided. Executor self-classification is not an allowed value.

classification_rationale.description: Why the classifier landed where it did, so the human can disagree with a reason.

human_review.description: Gate 2. Filled in by a person, never by an agent.
